ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=30 dolphinscheduler-2 bash -s <<'"'"'EOF'"'"'
set -e
python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json, subprocess, datetime as dt, os, shutil
H = "/opt/bigdata/hadoop-3.3.6/bin/hdfs"
BASE = "/user/hadoop/etl_state/state/pipeline_runner"
STEPS = "/home/ec2-user/pipeline-runner/steps/full_chain.json"
KEY = "2026-11-09#00"
KEEP = {"dim_user_snap_d"}  # 快照留给 rerun，不 SKIPPED

plan = json.load(open(STEPS))
# g_day_close_all steps
gsteps = plan["groups"]["g_day_close_all"]["steps"]
# only day-unit steps in that group
unit = {s["name"]: s.get("unit","day") for s in plan["steps"]}
day_steps = [s for s in gsteps if unit.get(s) != "hour"]
print("day_steps_in_g_day_close_all", len(day_steps))
for s in day_steps:
    print(" ", s)

def hdfs(*a, inp=None):
    return subprocess.run(["sudo","-n","-u","hadoop", H, "dfs", *a], input=inp, capture_output=True, text=True)

# read existing statuses
ls = hdfs("-ls", f"{BASE}/{KEY}")
present = {}
for line in ls.stdout.splitlines():
    if not line.endswith(".json"): continue
    path = line.split()[-1]
    name = path.rsplit("/",1)[-1][:-5]
    present[name] = path
print("present_marks", sorted(present))

status = {}
if present:
    out = hdfs("-cat", *[f"{BASE}/{KEY}/{n}.json" for n in present]).stdout
    # may be concatenated
    buf = out.replace("}{","}\n{")
    for line in buf.splitlines():
        try:
            n=json.loads(line)
            status[n.get("step")] = n.get("status")
        except Exception:
            pass
for s,st in sorted(status.items()):
    print(f"  status {s}={st}")

# todo: day steps not SUCCESS/SKIPPED, except KEEP
todo=[]
for s in day_steps:
    if s in KEEP:
        print(f"KEEP {s} status={status.get(s)}")
        continue
    st = status.get(s)
    if st in ("SUCCESS","SKIPPED"):
        continue
    todo.append((s, st))
print("TODO_SKIP", len(todo))
